mapper.select: SELECT lifecycle_scenario_id FROM lifecycle_scenario WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, lifecycle_scenario_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id AS scenario_id, scenario.scenario_name, scenario.description, scenario.base_date, scenario.status, COUNT(event.lifecycle_event_id) AS event_count FROM lifecycle_scenario scenario LEFT JOIN lifecycle_event event ON event.lifecycle_scenario_id = scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id WHERE scenario.user_id = #{userId} AND scenario.status != 'ARCHIVED' GROUP BY scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id, scenario.scenario_name, scenario.description, scenario.base_date, scenario.status ORDER BY scenario.updated_at DESC, scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id DESC

SELECT scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id AS scenario_id, scenario.scenario_name, scenario.description, scenario.base_date, scenario.status, COUNT(event.lifecycle_event_id) AS event_count FROM lifecycle_scenario scenario LEFT JOIN lifecycle_event event ON event.lifecycle_scenario_id = scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id WHERE scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND scenario.user_id = #{userId} AND scenario.status != 'ARCHIVED' GROUP BY scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id, scenario.scenario_name, scenario.description, scenario.base_date, scenario.status
mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS lifecycle_scenario_result ( lifecycle_scenario_result_id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, lifecycle_scenario_id BIGINT NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, scenario_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, result_version INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, simulated_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL, event_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_event_cost DECIMAL(19,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, total_funding_shortage DECIMAL(19,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, initial_net_asset DECIMAL(19,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, final_net_asset DECIMAL(19,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, net_asset_change DECIMAL(19,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, final_monthly_saving_capacity DECIMAL(19,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, final_dsr DECIMAL(9,4) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ordered_expense_amounts_json LONGTEXT NULL, ordered_event_costs_json LONGTEXT NULL, one_time_cost_breakdown_json LONGTEXT NULL, monthly_expense_breakdown_json LONGTEXT NULL, detailed_analysis_json LONGTEXT NULL, created_at DATETIME(6) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), PRIMARY KEY (lifecycle_scenario_result_id), UNIQUE KEY uk_lifecycle_result_scenario (lifecycle_scenario_id), KEY idx_lifecycle_result_user (user_id, simulated_at) )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lifecycle_scenario_result ( lifecycle_scenario_id, user_id, scenario_name, result_version, simulated_at, event_count, total_event_cost, total_funding_shortage, initial_net_asset, final_net_asset, net_asset_change, final_monthly_saving_capacity, final_dsr, ordered_expense_amounts_json, ordered_event_costs_json, one_time_cost_breakdown_json, monthly_expense_breakdown_json, detailed_analysis_json ) SELECT scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id, scenario.user_id, scenario.scenario_name, 1, #{result.simulatedAt}, #{result.eventCount}, #{result.totalEventCost}, #{result.totalFundingShortage}, #{result.initialNetAsset}, #{result.finalNetAsset}, #{result.netAssetChange}, #{result.finalMonthlySavingCapacity}, #{result.finalDsr}, #{orderedExpenseAmountsJson}, #{orderedEventCostsJson}, #{oneTimeCostBreakdownJson}, #{monthlyExpenseBreakdownJson}, #{detailedAnalysisJson} FROM lifecycle_scenario scenario WHERE scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id = #{scenarioId} AND scenario.user_id = #{userId} ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE scenario_name = VALUES(scenario_name), result_version = result_version + 1, simulated_at = VALUES(simulated_at), event_count = VALUES(event_count), total_event_cost = VALUES(total_event_cost), total_funding_shortage = VALUES(total_funding_shortage), initial_net_asset = VALUES(initial_net_asset), final_net_asset = VALUES(final_net_asset), net_asset_change = VALUES(net_asset_change), final_monthly_saving_capacity = VALUES(final_monthly_saving_capacity), final_dsr = VALUES(final_dsr), ordered_expense_amounts_json = VALUES(ordered_expense_amounts_json), ordered_event_costs_json = VALUES(ordered_event_costs_json), one_time_cost_breakdown_json = VALUES(one_time_cost_breakdown_json), monthly_expense_breakdown_json = VALUES(monthly_expense_breakdown_json), detailed_analysis_json = VALUES(detailed_analysis_json)

INSERT IGNORE INTO lifecycle_scenario_result ( lifecycle_scenario_id, user_id, scenario_name, result_version, simulated_at, event_count, total_event_cost, total_funding_shortage, initial_net_asset, final_net_asset, net_asset_change, final_monthly_saving_capacity, final_dsr ) SELECT scenario.lifecycle_scenario_id, scenario.user_id, scenario.scenario_name, 1, COALESCE( STR_TO_DATE( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(scenario.result_data, '$.simulatedAt')), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%f' ), STR_TO_DATE( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(scenario.result_data, '$.simulatedAt')), '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s' ), scenario.updated_at, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ), COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(scenario.result_data, '$.eventCount')) AS SIGNED), 0), COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(scenario.result_data, '$.totalEventCost')) AS DECIMAL(19,2)), 0), COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(scenario.result_data, '$.totalFundingShortage')) AS DECIMAL(19,2)), 0), COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(scenario.result_data, '$.initialNetAsset')) AS DECIMAL(19,2)), 0), COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(scenario.result_data, '$.finalNetAsset')) AS DECIMAL(19,2)), 0), COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(scenario.result_data, '$.netAssetChange')) AS DECIMAL(19,2)), 0), COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(scenario.result_data, '$.finalMonthlySavingCapacity')) AS DECIMAL(19,2)), 0), COALESCE(CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(scenario.result_data, '$.finalDsr')) AS DECIMAL(9,4)), 0) FROM lifecycle_scenario scenario WHERE scenario.user_id = #{userId} AND scenario.result_data IS NOT NULL AND JSON_VALID(scenario.result_data)
mapper.select: SELECT lifecycle_scenario_result_id, lifecycle_scenario_id, scenario_name, simulated_at, event_count, total_event_cost, total_funding_shortage, initial_net_asset, final_net_asset, net_asset_change, final_monthly_saving_capacity, final_dsr, ordered_expense_amounts_json, ordered_event_costs_json, one_time_cost_breakdown_json, monthly_expense_breakdown_json, detailed_analysis_json FROM lifecycle_scenario_result WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY simulated_at DESC, lifecycle_scenario_result_id DESC LIMIT 1
